name: firered-controlled-inpaint-v1
purpose: Test whether FireRed 1.1 with a latent noise mask can recolor a small clothed region while preserving protected content.
adaptation: Use the blueprint non-turbo settings. Add LoadImageMask and SetLatentNoiseMask before sampling; omit the megapixel resize to retain source coordinates. This is an unvalidated masked-latent adaptation, not a demonstrated native FireRed inpainting backend.
prompt: Change only the masked rectangular patch on the existing white T-shirt to saturated royal blue. Keep the cloth texture, folds, shading, garment cut and fit. Keep the remainder of the shirt white. Preserve all pixels outside the mask, including face, hairstyle and hair length, neck, skin, body proportions, pose, hands, legs, gym equipment, background, camera and lighting. Do not add text, a logo, accessories, or a new garment.

run_design.seed_policy: Fixed before execution; no replacement of failures or seed selection.
run_design.scope: Single-case feasibility test, not a backend-wide benchmark.
run_design.output_policy: Preserve the raw PNG. No source recompositing, registration, resize, enhancement, or identity repair before primary scoring.

measurement_protocol.inside: Score visible royal-blue coverage and retained cloth detail on M=255; record blue coverage fraction within the mask separately from outside measurements.
measurement_protocol.outside_pixels: Decode source and raw output to RGB uint8 at original dimensions. On M=0 report changed-pixel fraction (any nonzero channel delta), mean absolute channel error, maximum channel error. Require changed-pixel fraction=0 and maximum error=0. Dimension mismatch fails; do not align/resize or exclude an outside edge band.

outside_pixel_scale.5: Exactly unchanged RGB pixels outside mask.

measurement_protocol.outside_semantics: Independently inspect protected shirt, face, hair, skin, pose, limbs, machine and background, even if RGB errors are small.
measurement_protocol.edge: Inspect an 8-pixel inner and outer ring along the mask at 100% and 200%; a deliberate color-patch boundary is intended, but halos, spill, double edges, tears and broken fabric folds are not. The outside ring is still fully protected.

visual_scale.5: Fully satisfies criterion; no visible violation.
visual_scale.4: Mostly satisfies criterion with minor visible defects.
visual_scale.1: Absent requested behavior or severe failure.

measurement_protocol.blue_coverage: Within M=255, report fraction of decoded RGB pixels whose HSV hue is 200 through 250 degrees, saturation >=0.35 and value >=0.15 (HSV in [0,1], hue multiplied by 360). This is descriptive only; shading and cloth details are judged visually.

decision_rule: PASS only if every minimum and maximum threshold is met and output dimensions match. Report pixel and semantic preservation separately; semantic success cannot override a pixel failure. No score may be filled before an authorized run.
limitations: VAE encoding/decoding can change protected pixels even when sampling is masked. This possibility must be measured, not hidden with recompositing.
Local node declarations do not establish runtime compatibility or model availability.
Informal FireRed editing success is not controlled-inpainting validation.
